Name: powershell.exe
CommandLine: "powershell.exe" -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 7148 -State Listen -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1; $pid0 = $listener.OwningProcess; $rows = @(); $seen = @{}; $pid = $pid0; for ($i=0; $i -lt 6 -and $pid -gt 0 -and -not $seen.ContainsKey($pid); $i++) { $seen[$pid]=$true; $p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"ProcessId=$pid\" -ErrorAction Stop; $rows += [pscustomobject]@{Depth=$i; ProcessId=$p.ProcessId; ParentProcessId=$p.ParentProcessId; Name=$p.Name; ExecutablePath=$p.ExecutablePath; CommandLine=$p.CommandLine}; $pid = $p.ParentProcessId }; $rows | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 | Set-Content -LiteralPath '.gptremote-process-diagnostic.json' -Encoding UTF8"
